enemies.name: Army Elite Crossbowman
enemies.flavour_text: Elite crossbowmen of the Ursus Army, equipped with heavy weapons that can penetrate thick armor. They typically operate in a squad with multiple mobile crossbowmen, ensuring plenty of firepower.

abilities.text: Cannot perform ranged attacks if allied units or <Miner Guerrillas> are nearby
Interference area decreased when under a commander's orders

enemies.name: Army Light Artillery
enemies.flavour_text: Standard-issue light artillery of the Ursus Army, typically used for city defense. Aging artillery are passed down to the Patrol Units, as they are still perfectly adequate for the task of suppressing rebellions.

abilities.text: Attacks leave behind a burning area
Prioritizes <Miner Guerrillas> when under a commander's orders

enemies.name: Fortbreaker Mk-II
enemies.flavour_text: Next-generation war machine developed by the First Arsenal of Ursus, with increased power output and ammo capacity. The trade-off is that the pilot's escape pod was removed.

abilities.text: Can only be blocked by units with at least 3 Block; can fight 3 <Miner Guerrillas> at a time
Fires several rockets, dealing AoE damage
Fires more rockets when under a commander's orders

enemies.name: Army Frontline Commander
enemies.flavour_text: Frontline commanders of the Ursus Army, who have received rigorous training and education from the military academy from a young age, ensuring their absolute loyalty to the empire.

abilities.text: Gives orders to Army enemies on the field
Can fight 1 <Miner Guerrilla> at a time

enemies.name: Army Senior Commander
enemies.flavour_text: Senior commanders of the Ursus Army. Their loyalty to Ursus is beyond doubt, signified by the emblems of nobility on their uniform.

abilities.text: Gives orders to Army enemies on the field
Can fight 1 <Miner Guerrilla> at a time

enemies.name: Abnormal Originium Slug α
enemies.flavour_text: Dangerous mutated Originium slugs that are reproducing rapidly in the new underground environment. Rapid genetic iterations have increased their threat considerably.

abilities.text: More likely to be attacked by friendly units; takes less damage, and deals Arts damage to the attacker when attacked
Loses abilities after being attacked several times by <Miner Guerrillas>

enemies.name: Abnormal Manglerbeast α
enemies.flavour_text: Mutated beast that dwells within the mines. As the number of living creatures dwindled, the starving beast cut deep claw marks on the rock walls. Black rocks grew along the blood, climbing up the beast's famished hide, making it massive and terrifying once more.

abilities.text: More likely to be attacked by friendly units; takes less damage, and gains ASPD
Loses abilities after being attacked several times by <Miner Guerrillas>

enemies.name: 'Core of Stupor'
enemies.flavour_text: Originating from the ignorance and confusion in the deepest depths of thought, it eats away at reason until all are dragged into the abyss of nothingness.

abilities.text: Flying unit.
Self-destructs when nearing allied units, dealing AoE Arts damage and afflicting <Miner Guerrillas> with Fear

enemies.name: Yurodstvo
enemies.flavour_text: Do not complain. Do not hesitate. Do not struggle. Just accept it.

abilities.text: Cannot be blocked and spreads Toxic Pollution at its location
First Form
[Cocoon of Ignorance] Deals Arts damage to nearby allied units, inflicting Fear on <Miner Guerrillas> and causing them to lose visibility; <Miner Guerrillas> lose Fear when their HP is at max
[Spiritual Burden] Every 4th attack gains increased ATK and creates [Dominion] around the target; target is instantly defeated if already within [Dominion]
Second Form
Enters a new battlefield and spreads Toxic Pollution throughout the field
Attacks deal Arts damage 5 times, prioritizing different targets
[Spreading Fear] Summons a number of <Cores of Stupor>

[Vapid Chaos] For every 20% HP lost, Yurodstvo deals Arts damage to nearby allied units, inflicting Fear on <Miner Guerrillas> and causing them to lose visibility; <Miner Guerrillas> lose Fear when their HP is at max

enemies.name: 'Emperor's Blade', Halberd Breaker
enemies.flavour_text: His actions are the will of Ursus. The breaking of a Blade perhaps signifies that this will is wavering.

enemies.name: Army Infiltrator
enemies.flavour_text: Members of the Ursus Infiltrator Squad. They have already infiltrated every corner of the battlefield, waiting for a chance to strike when the main Army arrives.

abilities.text: Cannot be blocked.
Can fight 1 <Miner Guerrilla> at a time

enemies.name: Army Phantom
enemies.flavour_text: Members of the Ursus Phantom Infiltrator Squad. Equipped with advanced stealth gear, they are tasked with performing the decapitation strike when battle begins.

abilities.text: Cannot be blocked.
Can fight 1 <Miner Guerrilla> at a time

enemies.name: Army Mobile Crossbowman
enemies.flavour_text: Mobile crossbowmen of the Ursus Army, pushing on the flanks to disrupt and contain the enemy. Cheap to recruit and train, they are often deployed in large numbers.

abilities.text: Cannot perform ranged attacks if allied units or <Miner Guerrillas> are nearby
Interference area decreased when under a commander's orders

enemies.name: Army Heavy Artillery
enemies.flavour_text: Heavy artillery manufactured by the Ursus Army, first revealed at the Grypherburg Grand Parade five years ago. Rumors say that a single shell from one can engulf an entire city block in flames, but the number of units in service remains unknown.

abilities.text: Attacks leave behind a burning area
Prioritizes <Miner Guerrillas> when under a commander's orders

enemies.name: Fortbreaker
enemies.flavour_text: War machine developed by the First Arsenal of Ursus, representing the cutting-edge of Ursus's military technology. Only used in important battles due to massive energy requirements.

abilities.text: Can only be blocked by units with at least 3 Block; can fight 3 <Miner Guerrillas> at a time
Fires several rockets, dealing AoE damage
Fires more rockets when under a commander's orders

enemies.name: Army Shieldguard
enemies.flavour_text: Shieldguards of the Ursus Army. In the distance, a faint black line presses slowly forward. No one knows what their massive shields signify, only that screams keep coming from the cloud of dust in their wake.

abilities.text: More likely to be attacked by friendly units; can fight 3 <Miner Guerrillas> at a time
Takes less damage when under a commander's orders

enemies.name: Army Veteran Shieldguard
enemies.flavour_text: Veteran Shieldguards of the Ursus army, responsible for defending the command headquarters. Any enemy that makes it that far will not make it past the final line of defense.

abilities.text: More likely to be attacked by friendly units; can fight 3 <Miner Guerrillas> at a time
Takes less damage when under a commander's orders

enemies.name: Abnormal Originium Slug
enemies.flavour_text: These Originium slugs have mutated due to the environmental changes in the mines, caused by an unknown substance. Approach with care, as they are highly unstable.

abilities.text: More likely to be attacked by friendly units; takes less damage, and deals Arts damage to the attacker when attacked
Loses abilities after being attacked several times by <Miner Guerrillas>

enemies.name: Abnormal Manglerbeast
enemies.flavour_text: Mutated beast that dwells within the mines. It knew to avoid the strange rocks, but could not avoid drinking the black water. It lay on the gravel for several days, before standing up again.

abilities.text: More likely to be attacked by friendly units; takes less damage, and gains ASPD
Loses abilities after being attacked several times by <Miner Guerrillas>
